extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet. SS54B uses the SS52B-SS54B grouped values for maximum forward voltage and the SS52B-SS56B solid curves in Fig. 3 and Fig. 4.

Fig. 3 forward-voltage curve was digitized for the solid SS52B-SS54B curve at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. Fig. 4 reverse-characteristic curves were digitized for the solid SS52B-SS56B curves at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC. Points are readings from the supplied plots, not interpolated table values.

The maximum reverse-current table value for SS54B is 0.2 mA at VR = VDC = 40 V and TA = 25 degC. The same table gives 10 mA at TA = 100 degC; the required reverse_current field records the 25 degC row.
Typical junction capacitance is 300 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz, represented as 3.0e-10 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for SS54B include VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 5.0 A, IFSM = 120 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, and Tj = -55 to +125 degC. These ratings are not breakdown characterization data.
The supplied PDF identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.; the top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.

The PDF also contains forward-current derating and non-repetitive surge-current rating plots; they are not diode IV or reverse-characteristic curves and are retained only as rating evidence in this extraction note.
omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time or reverse-breakdown characteristic; reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current remain null.
